feed.title: Hill Money Watch
feed.subtitle: Congressional and executive-branch stock-trade disclosures, read closely.

entry.title: Hill Money Watch: October 12, 2026
entry.summary: A quiet week for the active roster: no new filings from Pelosi, Fields, Evans or Rick Scott, and Trump's August-trades report is not posted yet. The big number is a catch-up the last edition missed: Sen. Jim Justice disclosed a partial sale of the Greenbrier in the over-$50M band. Also: Ro Khanna's 400-line September filing and Rep. Diana Harshbarger's $1.85M–6.75M into KKR and Coatue private-markets funds.

entry.title: Hill Money Watch: October 3, 2026
entry.summary: Cleo Fields filed five new tech buys on October 1, Trump's accounts disclosed 1,156 July trades including $5M–25M sales of Microsoft and Amazon, and the Senate killed the House stock-trading ban 53–47 on September 30.

entry.title: Hill Money Watch: September 23, 2026
entry.summary: Nancy Pelosi's household opened a $3M–12M position in Bloom Energy and added to Intel, the first move on either side of the open Intel divergence since June. Cleo Fields's missing August buy turned up after all, April McClain Delaney sold 23 positions of $100K or more in one day, and the chair of the House Ethics Committee disclosed three trades about eight months after they were made.

entry.title: Hill Money Watch: August 16, 2026
entry.summary: Three House members disclosed late trades on the same day, led by a $100K–250K Apple sale Shri Thanedar sat on for seven months. The Tier-1 roster is quiet across the board, Cleo Fields is now five weeks past his own buying cadence, and Ro Khanna's TD filing date has picked up a third conflicting value.

entry.title: Hill Money Watch: August 15, 2026
entry.summary: A catch-up edition covering recent disclosures rather than a single trading day. Lisa McClain breaks a six-month silence with a private defense buy filed one day before a $3.2B state announcement; the Tier-1 roster is quiet; two members disclose large batches of late trades.
